evals.name: full-pipeline-interactive-scrollytelling
evals.prompt: I want to design a futuristic AI data provenance landing page called 'Provenance Labs'. Run the stitch-craft pipeline: start by discovering local design skills, interview me to create brief.md, craft the 4-beat Stitch generation prompt, and design a scrollytelling narrative.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes Phase 0 discovery, asks the 5-point discovery interview, writes brief.md, crafts an Awwwards-caliber 4-beat Stitch prompt with wide H1 and gapless bento grid, and specifies the scrollytelling motion layout with reduced-motion fallbacks.

assertions.name: executes-skill-discovery
assertions.description: Scans and merges machine design skills (gpt-taste, stitch-design-taste, scrollytelling)

assertions.name: interviews-before-generating
assertions.description: Does not blindly send prompts to Stitch; conducts the 5-point interview to establish brief.md

assertions.name: scrollytelling-with-reduced-motion
assertions.description: Defines narrative scroll stages with explicit prefers-reduced-motion: reduce handling

evals.name: responsive-and-anti-slop-audit
evals.prompt: Here is our draft landing page code. Run the Stitch Responsive Review across Desktop (1440px), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (375px) to catch overflow-x drift, broken bento grids, and generic AI design clichés.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs discover_and_verify.sh capture or verify_responsive.py, identifies mobile breakages (such as lack of clamp, col-span overflows, or missing overflow-x guards), checks color and typography tokens, and provides concrete fixes.

assertions.name: audits-three-viewports
assertions.description: Specifically checks Desktop 1440px, Tablet 768px, and Mobile 375px

assertions.name: detects-responsive-breakages
assertions.description: Catches horizontal overflow, unconstrained widths, and bento grid collapse

assertions.name: enforces-design-taste-rules
assertions.description: Bans neon purple-blue gradients, enforces single accent color and modern typography

evals.name: awwwards-story-and-pacing-review
evals.prompt: Our scrollytelling animations feel jarring and overwhelming. Review the motion design as an Awwwards Site of the Day judge: check narrative pacing, particle density, and readability over moving backgrounds.
evals.expected_output: The agent performs the Story Review: enforces 100vh+ breathing room per chapter, applies the 50% particle cut rule, adds backdrop blur scrims for readability, and purges robotic AI copywriting clichés.

assertions.name: checks-narrative-pacing
assertions.description: Verifies scroll runway (100vh-200vh) and non-linear intentional easing curves

assertions.name: cuts-visual-noise
assertions.description: Reduces particle count by 40-60% and lowers background opacity

assertions.name: enforces-text-readability
assertions.description: Requires backdrop scrims or blurs when text scrolls across moving elements

assertions.name: purges-ai-copy-cliches
assertions.description: Flags and replaces cliché phrases like 'Unleash the future' with authentic editorial copy
